editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ABP Pediatric Cardiology certification test covering 21 domains including normal cardiovascular structure and basic pharmacology.
editorial.overview: The ABP Pediatric Cardiology certification test spans 21 distinct domains administered by the American Board of Pediatrics. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency across numerous clinical subjects, ranging from normal cardiovascular structure and basic pharmacology to complex congenital heart defects, arrhythmias, single-ventricle lesions, intensive care management, and adult congenital heart disease.
editorial.who_should_take: Pediatric cardiology fellows and practicing physicians seeking formal board certification from the American Board of Pediatrics. Candidates must demonstrate extensive clinical competence across all 21 specific cardiovascular domains outlined in the official exam guide.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official content outline published by the American Board of Pediatrics. Focus study efforts across all 21 domains, paying close attention to weighted sections like preventative cardiology, congenital heart defects, and intensive care management. Complete practice questions to meet the 180 passing score requirement within the 270-minute time limit.

methodology.summary: This index is compiled using verified facts from official certification documentation, ensuring accurate information regarding domain weights, scoring thresholds, testing durations, and structural requirements for candidates preparing for the board evaluation.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time effectively during the 270-minute duration. Pace yourself across all 21 content domains to ensure you have adequate time to address every section before submitting your answers.

faq.answer_text: The official passing score for this board certification examination is set at 180. All candidates must meet or exceed this specific numerical score requirement to achieve board certification in pediatric cardiology.

The entire certification examination has a total allocated duration of 270 minutes. Test-takers should carefully monitor their pacing across the 21 individual domains throughout this entire testing period.

This specialty clinical examination is administered directly by the American Board of Pediatrics, which establishes all official content guidelines, scoring thresholds, and certification standards for qualified medical candidates.

The evaluation covers exactly 21 distinct content domains spanning various clinical subjects from basic pharmacology and normal cardiovascular structure to intensive care management and adult congenital heart disease.
